verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing line on the homepage saying Hummingbird "moves cases between agents and your team." That implies built-in agents that take on delegated case work, but the docs never describe an AI assistant, how a user delegates tasks to it, or what it can do. Missing for 10: documentation that the agents are AI, a described user-facing way to delegate tasks, the assistant's scope and capabilities, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
